      org.dreambot.api.wrappers.items.Item bag()
      The bag in the inventory. Null when none is carried. XPE method.

      Whether a bag is carried. XPE method.
      boolean isOpen()
      Whether the bag is open, so loot picked up in the Wilderness goes into it. XPE method.
      boolean isOpenKnown()
      Whether the open state is known at all. False on a fresh script until the bag is toggled or the game mentions it. XPE method.
      boolean canStore()
      Whether you are somewhere the bag fills. Answers the Wilderness part, which is what a script can know for certain; on a PvP world it says false in a hotspot where the bag would in fact work. The contents. XPE method.

      The contents, as real items with id, amount and slot. Empty while unknown. XPE method.
      int count​(int id)
      count helper. XPE method.
      int count​(java.lang.String name)
      How many of an item the bag holds, by id or by name. -1 while the contents are unknown, because an unchecked bag is not an empty one. XPE method.
      boolean contains​(int id)
      contains helper. XPE method.
      boolean contains​(java.lang.String name)
      Whether the bag holds at least one. False while unknown. XPE method.
      int slotsUsed()
      slotsUsed helper. XPE method.
      int freeSlots()
      Stacks in use and stacks free, of 28. Both -1 while unknown. A stack counts as one slot, the way the inventory works. XPE method.
      boolean isFull()
      Whether the bag will take no more. Counted from the live stack count, and also taken from the game refusing an item when that is the more recent of the two. XPE method.
      boolean isEmpty()
      Whether the bag holds nothing. False while unknown. XPE method.
      java.lang.String describe()
      The contents in words, for a log line. XPE method.
      long lastUpdate()
      When the contents last arrived, or 0. XPE method.
      void forget()
      Drops both the contents and the open state, for a script that knows the bag changed hands. XPE method.
      boolean check()
      Clicks Check and waits for the contents to arrive. Success is a fresh snapshot landing, not anything on screen. XPE method.
      boolean open()
      Opens the bag, so picked-up loot goes into it. Confirmed by the game saying so, since the item does not change. XPE method.
      boolean close()
      Closes the bag, so loot goes to the inventory again. Putting items in and banking the contents are not covered. Both go through interfaces the client has no widget dump of, and guessing component ids to click things in the Wilderness is not a trade worth m aking. XPE method.
      java.lang.String lastMessage()
      lastMessage helper. XPE method.
      long lastMessageAt()
      The last thing the game said about the bag, and when. Useful to print when the bag behaves unexpectedly. XPE method.
      long lastRejectedAt()
      When the game last refused an item for want of space, or 0. XPE method.
